Lauretta has fair hair that hangs down in two long braids.

## History

Lauretta was a fat, placid-looking eight-year-old child. Since her mother first carried her to church as a six-month-old infant, she conducted herself irreproachably while attending.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_
